description: Splits text for retrieval by estimated tokens, sentences or markdown headings, with token overlap and stable SHA-256 chunk ids. Returns { chunks: [{ id (sha-256 hex of the chunk text), index, text, tokens, start, end, heading? }], count, mode, size, overlap, family, method } Price: 2 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

family.description: Tokenizer family used for counts: cl100k, o200k, claude or llama (all estimates).

mode.description: Split by estimated tokens, by sentence boundaries, or by markdown heading sections (each chunk carries its heading).

overlap.description: Estimated tokens repeated from the end of one chunk at the start of the next; must be under half of size.

size.description: Target maximum estimated tokens per chunk, 32 to 4000.

text.description: Text or markdown to chunk, up to 60,000 characters.

name: chunk-text
title: RAG text chunker
